Good morning. My order ID is ORD-22006. 

Actually, I ordered a crockery set for Rs 2,199, but when the delivery person handed over the box, it was visibly crushed. I could actually hear broken pieces rattling inside before I even opened it. I took photos of the box before opening it just to be safe. Could you please check the delivery status and arrange for a replacement shipment or a refund for these carrier-damaged goods? Kindly do the needful.
